inventory.evidence: langgraph_runtime.py defines LangGraphAgentRuntimeV2 with StateGraph construction (lines 13-24) and graph.invoke probe (line 32). However runtime.py (line 7) returns NativeAgentRuntimeV2 singleton. api_adapter.py uses get_agent_runtime_v2() which returns NativeAgentRuntimeV2. LangGraphAgentRuntimeV2 is never instantiated in production routes.
inventory.notes: LangGraph code exists but is a dead/optional backend. The active runtime is NativeAgentRuntimeV2 which has zero LangGraph imports or graph invocations.

inventory.evidence: NativeAgentRuntimeV2 creates per-run directories under tmp_agent/agent_kernel_v2/runs/<run_id>/ with run.json, checkpoint.json, trace.jsonl (native_runtime.py lines 24-44, checkpoints.py lines 7-14). CheckpointStore saves status/step_index/plan. TraceStore appends events. This is file-based durable execution, not LangGraph checkpointer.
inventory.notes: Durable execution exists at file-system level per run_id. No thread_id/configurable checkpointing like LangGraph. Each run is independent; no resume from arbitrary step.

inventory.evidence: BrainSession.memory (MemoryManager) tracks conversation context (session.py line 306). get_context() returns recent turns. V2 uses context_assembler.assemble_recent_context (native_runtime.py line 77, api_adapter.py line 144). Token-aware truncation in session.py _truncate_to_budget.
inventory.notes: Short-term state works in both legacy /chat and V2 /v2/chat/agent paths.

inventory.evidence: SemanticMemory (semantic_memory.py) and SemanticMemoryFAISS (semantic_memory_faiss.py) provide FAISS-backed retrieval. MemoryGatewayV2.semantic_retrieve() calls get_semantic_memory_faiss().search() (memory_gateway.py line 41). ToolGatewayV2 exposes semantic_retrieve as read-only tool (tool_gateway.py lines 24, 69-71). V2 runtime uses it in operational_agent and brain_evidence routes (native_runtime.py lines 403-434). Legacy /chat has curated_lookup_readonly fastpath but no direct FAISS injection by default.
inventory.notes: Long-term memory exists and is readable via V2 routes. Legacy /chat does NOT automatically inject FAISS context (opt-in only via curated lookup). Memory writes (promotion) are gated behind separate pipeline, not chat.

inventory.evidence: semantic_memory_faiss.py implements FAISS index + ID mapping with search() returning top-k. MemoryGatewayV2 wraps it. ToolGatewayV2 exposes semantic_retrieve tool. Called during V2 operational_agent/brain_evidence routes (native_runtime.py lines 403-434). Legacy /chat does NOT call FAISS by default (only curated lookup fastpath).
inventory.notes: FAISS retrieval is real and callable via V2 tool gateway. Not activated for legacy chat unless user explicitly triggers curated lookup. No automatic semantic retrieval in chat path.

inventory.evidence: AgentV2IntentAdapter.get_evidence_sources() (intent_adapter.py lines 478-489) returns typed evidence sources for routes. Used in native_runtime.py lines 168-214 (brain_evidence) and 217-263 (mixed_brain_reasoning). No separate EvidenceSourceRouter class; routing is inside intent adapter.
inventory.notes: Evidence routing exists in V2 intent adapter and is activated for brain_evidence/mixed_brain_reasoning routes. Not used in legacy /chat.

inventory.evidence: planner.py (deterministic keyword/classification-based) builds plans with step_id/kind/tool/input (native_runtime.py line 267). finalizer.py does LLM synthesis with fallback chain (KIMI -> deepseek -> gpt-oss -> kimi-k2.5). AgentLoop has ReasoningResult/VerificationResult dataclasses and _emit_event for metacognition (loop.py lines 66-90). No separate evaluator class; verification is inline in AgentLoop.
inventory.notes: Planner is deterministic (not LLM-based). Finalizer is single LLM call with fallback. Legacy AgentLoop has verification step but no separate evaluator component. V2 does not call planner for direct_assistant/brain_evidence routes.

inventory.evidence: build_standard_executor() returns ToolExecutor with 100+ tools (tools.py). ToolGatewayV2 validates against capability list, enforces governance.py allowlist, executes with _bypass_gate for approved items (tool_gateway.py lines 69-71). Legacy path uses ToolExecutor directly in AgentLoop and _tool01_router. Governance gate integration via ExecutionGate.check in tool wrappers (tools.py lines 117-119, 170-171, 2419-2420).
inventory.notes: Tool execution is real and wired in both legacy and V2 paths. Governance integration active.

inventory.evidence: ExecutionGate singleton (execution_gate.py line 861) enforces P0-P3 risk, god mode, signed approvals. Tool wrappers call gate.check() (tools.py lines 170-171, 2419-2420). inventory.notes: Governance gate is fully active and enforced across all paths. Signed approval flow works for P3/protected paths.

inventory.evidence: signed_approvals.py creates/verifies HMAC tokens with actor/scope/action/target/nonce. ExecutionGate.approve() verifies token against BRAIN_SIGNED_APPROVAL_SECRET (line 790). Token required for P3/protected paths (line 741). 06C hardened endpoint checks signed_approval_validated flag.
inventory.notes: Signed approval flow is implemented and tested (05, 06B, 06C tests pass). Used for P3 and protected path tools.

inventory.evidence: finalizer.py lines 8-9, 189-225: PRIMARY_KIMI_MODEL = 'kimi-k2.6:cloud', FALLBACK_MODELS = ['deepseek-v4-pro:cloud', 'gpt-oss:120b-cloud', 'kimi-k2.5:cloud']. Linear fallback loop. LLMManager.query has model_priority and chains (llm.py). No arbitration beyond linear fallback. V2 routes all use finalizer; legacy uses LLMManager chain.
inventory.notes: Fallback is real and used. However it's a simple linear chain, not intelligent arbitration. V2 finalizer is the synthesis step for all routes.

inventory.notes: Streaming exists for legacy /chat via SSE. V2 agent path does not stream; returns full result after completion.

inventory.notes: Legacy /chat is a complex multi-route pipeline with many fastpaths. Does NOT use LangGraph, V2 runtime, or automatic FAISS retrieval. Tool execution is real but gated. Most queries resolve via fastpath or direct LLM.
